messages:
maria: thinking aloud / we should build a small deterministic eviction-sim harness + on-node capture so we can reproduce "non-deterministic" evict orders in postmortems. current logs don't give enough to replay.
aj: yes. goals: reproducible ordering, low perf overhead, privacy-safe. idea: three capture levels: none, minimal (meta only), full-trace (inputs+scores+tiebreak). default minimal.
lee: agree on levels. performance note: full-trace must be opt-in and gated by canary flags. for minimal we capture: tenant_hash, prefix, owner, lease_epoch, score_delta, reason.
sam: for full-trace we also record: observed metrics vector, eviction window snapshot, tie_breaker seed, and a compact op sequence so replay can step precisely. i propose storing as gzipped jsonl shards keyed by minute.
maria: what about replay fidelity? if scoring weights change we need to record the scoring version.
aj: record scorer_version, commit sha, and binary schema version. replay tool will support a compat map to say which scorer to use. also allow time-dilation: replay with original inter-event timing or step-mode. CLI: `evict-replay --input s3://... --mode=step --scorer=v1`
lee: implement capture as lock-free ring buffer per-worker, sampled flush to async writer, and a bounded backlog to avoid OOM. include a small metric for dropped-trace-count.
nina: compliance: tenant hashing must be HMAC using per-deployment salt stored in KMS. hosted: no reversible ids. provide toggle for private deployments. redact any user-visible keys.
aj: open questions: 1) should eviction-by-deadline events be prioritized in capture? 2) tie-breaker policy encoding: seq vs rng seed? my preference: sequence-based deterministic token appended to event.
sam: for replay harness we should support patching the scorer to run older weight sets (so we can test regressions). I can add a shim to load weights from the log or from a provided file.
lee: i'll add perf test that simulates 200k evict-events/min and measure p99 CPU overhead for minimal vs full-trace.
ops-bot: ticket created EDG-947 evict-replay-capture-proposal, assignees aj, sam, lee, nina.
maria: ok volunteers? aj spike capture, sam build replay harness, lee perf gating + canary, nina compliance + KMS. target PoC in 2w. :rocket:
